post.summary: Decline a pending or invited role request (Users admin widget)
post.description: A pending request, or an invited one whose setup link still works or ran out. An invited request’s link stops working (its lookup says canceled), and what the invite did is undone: a user the invite created who was never signed in to and has no password is removed from Accounts (the request’s userId becomes null); otherwise, when the invite gave the role and the user still holds it, they get their role from before back. 409 conflict when it is completed or declined; 404 not_found. 403 forbidden by the guards when the call names its acting user (SS-Actor-Id) or comes with a ticket: nobody changes their own role, blocks or deletes themselves, touches a user whose role ranks above theirs or gives a role ranking above theirs, and the last unblocked Owner stays.

post.summary: Invite the person of a pending request (Users admin widget)
post.description: Creates their user, or finds the user with that phone number (else email address), and answers a setup link for your staff to send, unless the user already has a password (the request is then completed). The role is given at the invite, or with Role requests → giveRoleAt set to completion when the request is completed (a new user has the default role until then, an existing user keeps theirs). 409 contact_unverified when that user never proved the phone or email and someone signed in to it (check with the person, confirm it on their user or remove that account, then invite again); 409 conflict when the request is not pending, its role is gone, another user has the contact, or the user's role ranks above the request's (a user has one role and a request never lowers it: change the role on their user if that is what you want); 404 not_found. 403 forbidden by the guards when the call names its acting user (SS-Actor-Id) or comes with a ticket: nobody changes their own role, blocks or deletes themselves, touches a user whose role ranks above theirs or gives a role ranking above theirs, and the last unblocked Owner stays.

post.summary: Decline a pending or invited role request
post.description: A pending request, or an invited one whose setup link still works or ran out. An invited request’s link stops working (its lookup says canceled), and what the invite did is undone: a user the invite created who was never signed in to and has no password is removed from Accounts (the request’s userId becomes null); otherwise, when the invite gave the role and the user still holds it, they get their role from before back. 409 conflict when it is completed or declined; 404 not_found. 403 forbidden by the guards when the call names its acting user (SS-Actor-Id) or comes with a ticket: nobody changes their own role, blocks or deletes themselves, touches a user whose role ranks above theirs or gives a role ranking above theirs, and the last unblocked Owner stays.

post.summary: Invite the person of a pending request
post.description: Creates their user, or finds the user with that phone number (else email address), and answers a setup link for your staff to send, unless the user already has a password (the request is then completed). The role is given at the invite, or with Role requests → giveRoleAt set to completion when the request is completed (a new user has the default role until then, an existing user keeps theirs). 409 contact_unverified when that user never proved the phone or email and someone signed in to it (check with the person, confirm it on their user or remove that account, then invite again); 409 conflict when the request is not pending, its role is gone, another user has the contact, or the user's role ranks above the request's (a user has one role and a request never lowers it: change the role on their user if that is what you want); 404 not_found. 403 forbidden by the guards when the call names its acting user (SS-Actor-Id) or comes with a ticket: nobody changes their own role, blocks or deletes themselves, touches a user whose role ranks above theirs or gives a role ranking above theirs, and the last unblocked Owner stays.

post.summary: Invite someone with a role
post.description: Makes an invited user and sends the invite link (inviteDays, default 7) by email when there is an address, else by SMS or WhatsApp (template accounts.invite); with deliver: return nothing is sent and the link comes back. 422 validation_failed for the field, or when invitePageUrl is not a page of your website; 409 already_exists; 503 notifications_not_connected and 502 not_sent (the invited user is removed again). 403 forbidden by the guards when the call names its acting user (SS-Actor-Id) or comes with a ticket: nobody changes their own role, blocks or deletes themselves, touches a user whose role ranks above theirs or gives a role ranking above theirs, and the last unblocked Owner stays.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A key of your own per request: the same request again within 24 hours gets the first answer (Idempotent-Replayed: true); another request with it answers 409 duplicate_request.

email.description: An email address or a phone number is needed; an address that is not valid is left out.

delete.description: scope=all (default) erases the user at once here and in every connected product, as an approved deletion request does; scope=accounts removes them from Accounts only (the user, their sessions and codes) and every other product keeps its data: use it to remove someone from your team. 404 not_found; 422 validation_failed for scope. 403 forbidden by the guards when the call names its acting user (SS-Actor-Id) or comes with a ticket: nobody changes their own role, blocks or deletes themselves, touches a user whose role ranks above theirs or gives a role ranking above theirs, and the last unblocked Owner stays.

post.summary: Decline a sign-up that waits for approval
post.description: The account is removed. 409 conflict when the user is not waiting; 404 not_found. 403 forbidden by the guards when the call names its acting user (SS-Actor-Id) or comes with a ticket: nobody changes their own role, blocks or deletes themselves, touches a user whose role ranks above theirs or gives a role ranking above theirs, and the last unblocked Owner stays.

post.summary: Approve a user’s deletion request
post.description: Erases the user here and in every connected product. 409 conflict when the user did not ask; 404 not_found. 403 forbidden by the guards when the call names its acting user (SS-Actor-Id) or comes with a ticket: nobody changes their own role, blocks or deletes themselves, touches a user whose role ranks above theirs or gives a role ranking above theirs, and the last unblocked Owner stays.

post.summary: Keep the account: drop a user’s deletion request
post.description: 409 conflict when the user did not ask; 404 not_found.

post.summary: A setup link for a user
post.description: The user chooses a password with it (POST /v1/setup-links/accept), also without an email address; valid setupDays (default 7). The link is your setupPageUrl with {code} replaced, else that page (or your website’s home page) with ?ss_setup=<code>. A new one cancels the old. 403 blocked; 404 not_found; 422 validation_failed when setupPageUrl is not a page of your website. 403 forbidden by the guards when the call names its acting user (SS-Actor-Id) or comes with a ticket: nobody changes their own role, blocks or deletes themselves, touches a user whose role ranks above theirs or gives a role ranking above theirs, and the last unblocked Owner stays.

post.summary: A one-time sign-in code for a user
post.description: 6 digits for your staff to give the user (never sent), valid codeMinutes (Staff sign-in codes and setup links, default 15), single use; typed into the phone code, email code or phone + password screen. A new one cancels the old. 403 blocked; 404 not_found. 403 forbidden by the guards when the call names its acting user (SS-Actor-Id) or comes with a ticket: nobody changes their own role, blocks or deletes themselves, touches a user whose role ranks above theirs or gives a role ranking above theirs, and the last unblocked Owner stays.

post.summary: Sign a user out of every device
post.description: Sign-ins already given end within 15 minutes. 404 not_found.
